lead.headline: Rice and Barkley sat out Wednesday; the matchup tightened
lead.deck: Neither of your two best bench players practised. Los Cachanillas fixed their byes and the game is now near even.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. You are 0-5, and neither Rashee Rice nor Saquon Barkley practised on Wednesday. Andy Reid said of Rice's hamstring, 'it could be a week, it could be two'; Barkley was absent from the open portion of Eagles practice, with Nick Sirianni still 'hopeful' and pointing to 'a lot of time left.' Both lineup calls stay where Tuesday left them: Rice into the flex for Pickens only if active at 12:55 Sunday, and Barkley for Tuten only if Friday's report clears him, because Tuten kicks off at Wembley two hours before Barkley's inactives. The other bad news is across the field: Los Cachanillas benched Chase and LaPorta, both on bye, at 17:20 UTC and now project 111.8 to your 116.6. ESPN has the game at about 52%, down from 71% this morning. In Chicago, Caleb Williams was a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report, which keeps Loveland in the tight-end seat. CeeDee Lamb practised fully, so Pickens is Dallas's No. 2 again.
